_about: Tier-3 abstain-gate SWEEP corpus (cross-source-entity-resolution.md §5, §10 Q6). Synthetic, hand-labeled STRESS set — NOT a natural mention distribution: bands were designed to sit on the deterministic scorer's decision boundaries (exact 1.0 / fuzzy 0.75 / 0.6667 / 0.6 / co-signal-saturated 1.0) so a (tau_nil, margin_delta) grid sweep has measurable cliffs. Unlike mention_cases.json (whose labels are outcome-taxonomy labels at the shipped default config), each case here carries a config-INDEPENDENT gold label: gold="account:x" means the mention truly refers to that catalog entity and the correct decision is to RESOLVE (tag or reviewer_hint — the tag gate is orthogonal to the abstain gates); gold=null means the correct decision is to ABSTAIN (unknown org, distinct near-miss org, or genuinely undecidable ambiguity). 'detector_spans' are deterministic scripted stand-ins for what an NER backstop would return — the sweep makes NO LLM calls; they exist because the gazetteer window pass only ever produces exact (1.0) matches, so tau_nil is exercisable only in the backstop regime. Cases with annex=true are containment-detection failures that NO gate setting can block; they are excluded from grid metrics and reported separately. Every case's rationale quotes scores MEASURED against the shipped pipeline at generation time (gen_sweep_corpus.py calibration).
